channel.title: Worship Connect Group — Resources
channel.description: Worship Connect Group helps churches build thriving worship ministries — vetted musician placement, team coaching, training through the Academy, and worship events.

item.title: How to Cover a Last-Minute Worship Gap Without the Panic
item.description: Your drummer texts sick on Saturday night and Sunday is coming. Here is a calm, repeatable plan for who to call, how to keep the set simple, and how to build a bench so the next gap does not sink you.
